name: Shanty Town
description: Shanty Town is the third chapter of the campaign Swamp Fever in Left 4 Dead 2. The Survivors find themselves in the community of Village En Marais, which is overrun by the Infected. This chapter is home to a Crescendo Event, in which a rusty ramp must be dropped to move to the next shack on stilts. The loud creaking of the rusted ramp attracts the Infected. There is a mixture of houses; some stand above the swamp water on stilts, others do not and are half flooded by the rising swamp waters.
